radiology_notes.text:
INDICATION:  Evaluate PICC line placement.

COMPARISON:  ___.

PORTABLE CHEST RADIOGRAPH:  Right-sided PICC is seen with tip at the distal
SVC.  Cardiac and mediastinal contours appear unremarkable.  Lungs appear
clear.

IMPRESSION:  Right-sided PICC with tip overlying the distal SVC.

INDICATION:  Chronic pancreatitis with recurrent abdominal pain.

COMPARISON:  MRCP ___.

TECHNIQUE:  Multiplanar T1- and T2-weighted images of the abdomen were
acquired on a 1.5 Tesla magnet including dynamic 3D imaging obtained prior to,
during, and after the uneventful intravenous administration of 0.1 mmol/kg of
gadolinium-DTPA.  Multiplanar 2D and 3D reformations along with subtraction
images were generated on independent workstation.

MRI OF THE ABDOMEN WITH AND WITHOUT INTRAVENOUS CONTRAST (MRCP):  Main
pancreatic duct demonstrates mild diffuse irregularity but is otherwise normal
in caliber without evidence of focal stenosis or dilatation.  Several small
dilated side branches are identified within the pancreatic neck and tail
measuring up to 4 mm wide.  The pancreatic parenchyma demonstrates mild
diffuse atrophy, but no focal masses are present.  No peripancreatic fluid
collections are demonstrated.  The pancreas enhances homogeneously post-
contrast administration.  No evidence for pancreas divisum.

Again demonstrated within segment VI of the liver is an 8-mm hemangioma,
unchanged.  A second, 5-mm well-circumscribed round lesion which is
homogeneously hypointense with respect to the liver parenchyma on T1-weighted
images and hyperintense on T2- weighted imaging is located within segment ___,
immediately anterior to the inferior vena cava. This lesion enhances, becoming
isointense with respect to the hepatic parenchyma on all post-contrast phases
of imaging and also likely represents another hemangioma, unchanged.  No new
focal masses are otherwise demonstrated.  No intra- or extra-hepatic biliary
duct dilatation is identified.  Hepatic arteries, hepatic veins, and portal
veins are widely patent.

The gallbladder is absent. The spleen, adrenal glands, left kidney, visualized
bowel loops are within normal limits.  7mm simple cyst is seen in the upper
pole of the right kidney. No hydronephrosis or new renal masses.  Abdominal
aorta is normal in caliber. No free fluid.  No pathologically enlarged
mesenteric or retroperitoneal lymph nodes.

No suspicious focal bone marrow signal abnormalities are identified.

Multiplanar 2D and 3D reformations were essential in providing multiple
perspectives for the dynamic series.

IMPRESSION:
1.  Mild irregularity of the main pancreatic duct with a few tiny dilated side
branches, findings compatible with prior pancreatitis.  No pancreatic duct
strictures or pseudocysts present.
2.  Two hemangiomas within the liver, unchanged.
3.  Simple right renal cyst.

AP CHEST 12:09 A.M ___  

HISTORY:  Pancreatitis.  PICC line.

IMPRESSION:  AP chest compared to ___:

Right PICC line has been removed.  New left PICC line ends at the superior
cavoatrial junction.  Lungs are clear.  There is no pleural abnormality,
evidence of central adenopathy or mediastinal widening.  Heart size is normal.
Pager ___ was paged as requested.
